instructions.question: Does the tweet carry an upbeat evaluation, a critical or unhappy one, or no evaluation at all?
instructions.rule: Look for evaluative wording. Upbeat words or emoticons (good, best, fun, perfect, nice, hope, :), <3, celebrate) with no complaint make a tweet positive, even in promotions or plans. Critical judgments of someone or something (hypocritical, bitter, flop, racist, couldn't cope, should reject) or personal setbacks, annoyance, sarcasm or harmful news make it negative. Neutral is only for tweets with no evaluation: logistics, bare 'who's going?' invitations, plain questions, stats, dry headlines and pure tactical description.

neutral.what: No evaluation: logistics, schedules, plain questions or invitations, stats, dry news, banter without a stance.
examples: So .... Who's up for seeing Ant-Man with me on Saturday? 2:30pm showing. Let me know!
Thursday's top stories including the latest in the lawsuit against Rolling Stone and Sabrina Erdely
neutral.cues: who's going, anyone wanna, dates, times, reports, said Monday, scores
neutral.not_for: Add any praise or warmth and it is positive; add any criticism, complaint or setback and it is negative.

positive.what: Any upbeat feeling or praise: excitement, affection, hope, warm promotions, fun plans, good news or achievements.
examples: Jason Aldean&Kenny Chesney tickets for sale. Concert is the 29th. Good seats for a really good price. Text me asap for more info!!
We always mess up when we get the chance to go up the table when Atleti or Barca mess up. PLEASE WIN TOMORROW :) @user
Roomie and I are moving into our new apartment tomorrow and then going to Disneyland in 3 days.
positive.cues: good, best, fun, perfect, can't wait, love, hope, see you there, :), <3, !!, Happy [day]
positive.not_for: Bare event listings, 'who's going with me?' and dry score lines are neutral.

negative.what: Criticism, contempt, complaints, setbacks, sarcasm, sadness, or news of violence or harm.
examples: "Caitlyn Jenner may not be ""down"" with gay marriage, but she should really understand that people are gonna see that as hypocritical."

A Thursday night with no Waterloo road on! #boring
negative.cues: hypocritical, bitter, flop, racist, reject, couldn't cope, haven't been able, argh, #boring, damn, worst, attack
negative.not_for: Strong words used in excitement are positive.
